scope.description: Implement a synthetic/frozen-oracle P5 production-facing evidence adapter, BQ-aware vertex-set ranker and topology_unit v2 serializer without changing production apps, validators, provenance, catalog or schema.

assumptions: Evo-M0 recurrence-allowed remains the primary structural model.
The abundance endpoint scores each complete-family vertex set exactly once and never chooses a parent mapping.
Incomplete, capped, deadline or abstaining families publish no abundance rank.
Historical Python is read-only contract evidence and is not a production implementation.

step_verify.step: Freeze R/A/O/X evidence semantics and active-bit compression.
step_verify.verify: Synthetic tests cover R/A/O/X parsing, deterministic q compression and BQ-derived read emissions under input permutation.

step_verify.step: Rank every complete-family vertex set once under the BQ-aware likelihood endpoint.
step_verify.verify: A small-q brute-force likelihood oracle matches the ranker, including a complete deterministic tie class with no parent mapping.

step_verify.step: Serialize a topology_unit v2 record without crossing structural, abundance, edge or unary-projection boundaries.
step_verify.verify: Complete family emits rank and optional post-family edge evidence; cap/deadline/incomplete states emit no rank; unary hidden chains remain unresolved projection-only.
Warnings-as-errors build, direct runtime test, targeted ctest, permutation/order invariance and negative incomplete/no-rank checks all exit zero.

evidence.command: /usr/bin/cmake --build build-cpp-output-validation --target test_runtime_solver --parallel 8 && ctest --test-dir build-cpp-output-validation --output-on-failure -R '^(runtime_solver|determinism_contract|topology_no_incomplete_winner)$' && validate five generated topology_unit v2 records && replay locale/order determinism and ASan/UBSan
evidence.output_excerpt: Warnings-as-errors build PASS; 3/3 targeted CTests PASS; dense small-q likelihood oracle, full tie class, fail-closed negatives, five schema-v2 records, locale/order determinism and ASan/UBSan all PASS.

deviations: The first sanitizer configure resolved the PATH-preferred /usr/local/bin/cmake 3.14.4 and exited 1 before compilation because the project requires CMake 3.22. The corrected /usr/bin/cmake 3.22.1 configure, warnings-as-errors build and ASan/UBSan runtime test exited 0.
clang-format and cppcheck were unavailable. No unapproved installation was attempted; compiler policy, git diff --check, schema validation and sanitizer replay passed.

During successor work, governance exposed stale evidence bindings in the released first-stage topology archive. An immutable p5_topology_first_stage_receipt.txt was reconstructed from its already-recorded command/exit/output and historical source hashes; the old ctest and status-registry evidence now bind that receipt and do not claim adapter evidence.
This task used only synthetic/frozen small oracles. It did not read HCC1395 data or modify CMake sources, apps, validators, provenance, schema, catalog or production authority.

The repository publication repair later replaced private absolute-path strings in the receipt with portable tokens. The input and evidence SHA values now bind that sanitized projection; solver counts and verdict fields were not changed.
